component.name: monocles chat
component.summary: Encrypted XMPP messaging with post-quantum PQ OMEMO2

description.p: monocles chat is a cross-platform Qt/QML XMPP client, wire- and feature-compatible with monocles chat for Android. Conversations are protected with post-quantum PQ OMEMO2 (PQXDH + SPQR) end-to-end encryption, and the local database is encrypted at rest with SQLCipher.

ul.li: 1:1 and group chats, reactions, replies, corrections, retraction and read markers
Audio and video calls (XEP-0166/0353 Jingle over GStreamer WebRTC)
Voice messages, stickers, encrypted file sharing, Stories and social Feeds

description.p: Initial packaged release of the Qt client.
